observations.prerequisites: Nine prior banquet subquests, Desert Treasure I, Horror from the Deep, 175 quest points. observations.route: After the banquet rescues, enter the portal for each of six separate fights. Each successful fight returns the player to Lumbridge Castle and opens the next encounter. The final win sets the RFD finale flag. The existing parent action later records the whole Recipe for Disaster without another reward.
observations.equipment_and_supplies: Ice gloves acquired through Heroes' Quest, two tradeable super restore(4) potions budgeted at an estimated 15,000 GP. Suitable multi-style combat gear and food are unmodeled because the pinned helper lists them as an open-ended requirement.
observations.completion_rewards: One RFD quest point, access to Barrows-glove purchase from the Culinaromancer's Chest, one bankable antique lamp giving 20,000 XP in a qualifying skill. The minimum base level is provisionally modeled as 50; exact interpretation of 'above 50' remains for live confirmation.
